dct_description_sm: This research investigates experiences and challenges for Inuit graduate students and graduates of the UPEI Master of Education Nunavut Leadership in Learning program that provides access to graduate education. The MEd Nunavut program is based primarily in Nunavut as a hybrid (face-to-face and distance delivery) graduate program. The experiences of the MEd graduate students and graduates provide important insights into the challenges and possibilities for delivery of university-based graduate programs in Nunavut, addressing the ongoing lack of access to university education in Nunavut as a whole.
